findings.title: Fallback to filterConditions when authConditions is missing can bypass authorization
findings.body: In `getBaseConditions()`, if `authConditions` were ever falsy and `filterConditions` were present, the `else if (filterConditions)` branch would return `filterConditions` alone without any authorization check. Even though `getAuthorizationConditions()` currently returns a `Prisma.Sql` object (`NOTHING_CONDITION` on failure), this fallback logic is dangerous for an authorization gate: if `authConditions` is ever `null`/`undefined`, the method should fail closed and return `NOTHING_CONDITION` rather than returning `filterConditions` unguarded.

findings.title: Removed caching tests for authorization and filter conditions
findings.body: The `describe("Caching", ...)` test block verifying that `getAuthorizationConditions()` and `getFilterConditions()` cache their results across calls was deleted in this PR, even though `InsightsBookingService` still implements `cachedAuthConditions` and `cachedFilterConditions`.
